candidates.change_summary: Delete the overflow check require statement so that balance can overflow on addition.
Replace the unlockTime assignment so that it always uses block.timestamp, ignoring the argument.
Delete the AddMessage log call so that the Log contract state is not updated.
Change the balance update from addition to assignment, overwriting previous balance with msg.value.
Remove the unlock-time check from the collect condition so funds can be withdrawn before the unlock time.
Remove the MinSum requirement so collectors can withdraw amounts smaller than MinSum.
Only check acc.balance against MinSum, ignoring _am, so a collector can withdraw more than their balance as long as their balance meets MinSum.
Remove the balance subtraction so a collector can withdraw the requested amount without decreasing their recorded balance.
Delete the entire if-condition body so Collect silently does nothing, making the balance remain unchanged.
Change the balance deduction to acc.balance = _am so the recorded balance is set to the withdrawal amount instead of being decreased.
